purpose: Separate material, graphic, semantic, transport and archival units in Hodgson paper evidence; prevent arithmetic or conceptual collapse across unit classes.
core_rule: A numerical relation between two paper/document units is never assumed unless a historical witness supplies the conversion relation.

research_rule: Always state what historical operation is doing the counting. If an archive says 1,863 sheets, retain sheets. If a catalogue says works, retain works. Convert only when a contemporary or reconstructible relation makes conversion historically demonstrable.
